maintainer: publish immutable release assets from the controlled build workstation
triage issues against the reported release tag, source commit, and archive SHA-256
land fixes on a review branch and publish a new release candidate
target_tester: verify the release checksum before extraction
run dry-run before any requested install
execute the manual scenario matrix on the physical controller
submit only GitHub-safe evidence through the hardware-test issue form
target_owner: approve signing, install, background, rollback, and Client2 RenderService decisions
retain raw device evidence through an approved internal channel
decide whether a physical application-layer result closes an ISSUE-027 field

withdrawn_unreleased_tags.reason: The generated checksum named an absolute workstation path; no GitHub Release or assets were published.

release_contract.reason: The complete Client2 baseline and signing inputs are controlled artifacts and are not committed to Git.

tester_workflow: download an immutable release and its external checksum
verify SHA-256 and extract the bundle
complete the target-input file without changing false production or hardware claims
run remote acceptance in dry-run mode
run an explicitly approved test install when required
run evidence collection again after the failure or pass
open a hardware-test issue using only github-safe evidence

issue_contract.issue_close_rule: Close only after a tester verifies a named replacement release on the target controller.

forbidden_github_content: hash derived from an ADB serial or raw build fingerprint
user utterance, model reply, memory, token, or vehicle payload

prohibited_operations: publish the repository or release assets publicly by default
commit original or reverse-engineered APK workspaces
commit signing keys, target-input files, device serials, or raw hardware logs
build the complete Client2 delivery from an incomplete GitHub checkout
install before checksum, API, ABI, package, and signer preflight
close production, NPU, VHAL, Driver/HAL, or hardware gates from application-layer evidence
